answer_1.quote: We aim to understand how different LLMs respond when prompted with hate speech... We analyse the reactions of seven state-of-the-art LLMs to more than 26 000 English hate speech sentences... they simply generate content in a vanilla mode.
answer_1.outputs: Responses to hate speech prompts and rephrased polite hate speech versions.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the revised models using both datasets, categorising responses into hate or nonhate speech with MetaHate BERT.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three annotators aged 25-35 with diverse backgrounds to evaluate the LLM outputs.
answer_4.guideline: annotation guidelines... defined by a group of experts after a pilot study... including an interaction to illustrate the category definitions.
